title: A serving job aborted every tensor-parallel worker at model build, twice, before the cause was named
symptom: vLLM 0.28's DeepSeek-V4 attention asserts an fp8 KV cache and the default aborted the build; separately, vllm serve rejected --disable-log-requests and exited immediately while the poll loop reported only 'server never became healthy' after its full interval.
root_cause: An unstated model requirement plus a removed CLI flag, both hidden behind a poll loop that reported a timeout instead of the server's own message.
correction_made: VLLM_KV_DTYPE added and set to fp8; the rejected flag removed; the early-exit branch prints the server's own message and the elapsed time so a rejected argument reads as a rejected argument.
